summary: Keep terminal admission and subscription independent of lazy screen codec loading

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Public SDK signatures remain unchanged. Terminal transport starts before its optional codec finishes loading. Complete screen replacements use a bounded latest-wins slot during loading; reset and stop discard obsolete screens. Codec failures retain the existing status-before-event failure channel.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or startup migration required.

manual.detail: No operator action or configuration change required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
